records.title: The National Commission for Indian system of medicine bill, 2019 and the National Commission for Homoepathy Bill, 2019
details: The Honourable Minister said inter-alia that:- The thing about Yoga and Naturopathy, as I said, the committee which went under the Chairman of NITI Aayog, had reclaimed that separate bills for Yoga and Naturopathy should be made. We have also prepared the bill and it is under consideration, I would definitely like to assure you. It is under consideration and we will consider it as soon as possible.

records.title: Implication of making Aadhar Card and mandatory for Direct Benefit Transfer Scheme
Action against CMO of CGHS Dispensary,R.K.Puram
Cases pending in various High Courts and Supreme Court
details: The suggestion by Shri Ram Gopal Yadav,M.P. whether any mechanisum would be put in place to make it compulsory for the judges of the High Courts to dispose of a certain number cases in time bound manner of fashion,it was stated that the suggestion would be considered.

records.title: British Parliamentarians for Enforcement of Law to check crulty against animals in India
details: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act,1960 and rules made thereunder to prevent cruelty to animals are alreay in force in the country. A comprehensive proposal for amendments in the existing Act in under consideration of the Govt to make it more effective and bring in tune with the latest developments on the subject.

records.title: Directive for quota of MPs for enrolling students in kendriya vidyalayas
details: The matter regarding dispensation admission of two children from the quota of those MPs who do not have any KV in their constituencies, is under consideration of the Govt.

records.title: Reported forfeiture of berth of a women passenger
details: The matter of cancellation of reserved berth in coach No. S-5 of Vikramshilha Magadh Express leaving Bhagalpur on 20.7.2000 and allotment of the same to some other passenger on some pecuniary consideration is under investigation.

records.title: Flouting of time fixation by KVS
details: The information regarding the flouting of recommendations of Dr.Vir Raghvan Committee by the Kendriya Vidayalaya Sangathan is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Recovery of outstanding dues from Sahara Airlines
details: To a supplementary by a Member regarding the outstanding amount payable by different private airlines ,it was stated that the details will be given later.

records.title: Irregulairities in the Cellular Phone service of MTNL
details: The Govt. have constituted a Committee of 3 Senior Officers to enquire into the irregularities in the Cellular Phone service launched by MTNL.Further action will be taken on the receipt of the report.

records.title: Mafia Dons of Bihar
details: As regarding News Item capitoned `Mafia Sargnanon Ka Kara Bihar` and the action proposed to taken again Mafia dons by putting a complete check on their criminal activities in Jails are being ascertained from the State Govt.

records.title: Ban on cabaret dance and beauty contests
The Constitution (One Hundred and Twenty firth Amendment) Bill, 2019
details: Hon'ble Minister inter-alia mentioned that if review petition is not accepted, we will ensure that a bill/ordinance will be brought by the Government.

records.title: Vacation of santushti complex
details: The information regarding the vacaction of santushti complex situated near Prime Minister`s residence and details thereof is being collected and will be laid on the Table fo the house.

records.title: Recovery of dues from Government hospitals and Police stations
details: Information regarding outstanding telephone bills against Government hospitals and Police Stations through out the country and action proposed to be taken to recover the entire amount has been called for and the same will be placed on the Table of the House.

records.title: Efficacy of child labour law
details: Government is considering to amend child Labour Act, 1980 to make it more effective for elimenation of Child labour

records.title: Fake Passports
details: The information regarding estimated number of people coming to India on fake passportsis being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.
